selection.purpose: Choose a configuration for independent warmup/search/300s capacity testing; no promotion or capacity/rank proof.
selection.new_correctness_binary_limit: Calibration metrics belong to the frozen a34 candidate. Any later correctness fixes create a new binary requiring its own validation and capacity run; these metrics are not silently transferred.

host_diagnostics.scope: Shared-host observations are diagnostic; no retrospective exclusions.

interpretation: Each arm is one fixed-load run. CPU and latency contrasts are descriptive; similar closed-model request rates cannot establish sustainable capacity. No extra grid or selective reruns are authorized by this audit.
